zh-CN.title: 空间投稿正式开放
items: 空间可以开放独立投稿入口，成员可选择官方或运营发起投稿
投稿在发送第一句话后才会创建，并与普通聊天会话分开管理
投稿群成员邀请需经官方或运营同意，新成员可查看完整投稿记录

en.title: Space submissions are here
items: Spaces can enable a dedicated submission tab where members can contact the official account or an operator
A submission is created only after the first message and stays separate from ordinary chats
New submission members require official or operator approval and can read the complete history
